description: Reviewed name mappings for unresolved local reference expressions. Names and definitions are verified against the matching official Wiki character page; local original text remains preserved.

0:-1,104700,1.name: 塔瑞兹

0:340602,1.name: 强酸倾压
0:340602,1.note: Wiki 对照也暴露了本地导出器尚未处理的带等级引用格式；同名本地显示行是 BattleBuffPerformData[340602]。

0:-1,107007,1.name: 靶心
0:-1,107007,1.note: 对应固键的正文没有悬浮标签，但原文明确写靶心；该角色其他技能中有同名悬浮说明。

0:-1,10770800,1.name: 拟合共鸣
